title: The End of the Silence

seeds.title: The Seeds of Tomorrow
lines: Emmanuel, Aline and those who walked with them came home, and began to rebuild.
Emmanuel became a teacher. Aline went back to her studies, and became a doctor.
Grief stayed. Reconciliation was neither simple nor quick. Some days it did not seem possible at all.
But they began. Quietly, and together.

names.title: The Names We Remember
lines: Emmanuel survived. Not everyone he tried to help did.
He gathered names, and stories, and wrote them down, so that the children who came after would know what hatred, propaganda and dehumanisation had done, and how it began: with words.
He became a teacher. Every year, his first lesson begins with a name.

long_road.title: A Long Road Home
lines: Emmanuel and Aline survived. Not everyone who reached the river with them crossed it together.
For months, Emmanuel searched: lists of the living pinned up at the camps, names read out on the radio, every face in every market.
He has not found everyone yet. He has not stopped looking.
There is a school to rebuild. He will rebuild it. But first, he is still searching.

rebuild.school: Within a year, the school had a roof again. Emmanuel teaches in the classroom where Madame Uwase once taught him, and she teaches next door.
rebuild.clinic: Aline and Emmanuel reopened the health post one room at a time. The first thing Aline did was write her own name on the door, as a promise.
rebuild.homes: That first year, Emmanuel rebuilt walls, one family at a time, for people who had nowhere else to return to.
rebuild.garden: Around the memorial a garden grew. People come to sit there, and read the names, and say them out loud.

aftermath.patrick: Patrick was arrested. He is in prison, awaiting trial. He will have to face what he did.
aftermath.patrick_asked: Some survivors say he sent the searchers the wrong way that last morning. It does not undo what he did.
aftermath.vestine: Vestine came to the memorial once, and stood at the back, and wept. Aline went and stood beside her.

opening_captions: Soldiers of the Rwandan Patriotic Army reached the area. For those who had survived, the killing there was over.

objectives.text: Visit the places that mattered: your father's house, the school, the hill
Join the others at the memorial in the square
